description: Decode percent-encoded text (decodeURIComponent or decodeURI). A broken % sequence gives a plain error. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

mode.description: component (default) encodes one part of an address, such as a query value, and also escapes / ? & = # and :. url keeps those characters, for a whole address.

plusAsSpace.description: Read + as a space, as in form data and query strings (default false).

name: url_decode
title: URL Encode and Decode
